parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y x x 2 6 2 = + - for values of x between -3 and 4. [2]

content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = 2x^{2} +x-6\) for values of \(x\) between \(-3\) and 4.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y x x 3 2 2 = + - for values of x between -3 and 4. [2]

content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = 3+2x-x^{2}\) for values of \(x\) between \(-3\) and 4.
Find the coordinates of the maximum of \(y = 3+2x-x^{2}\) .

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Find the x-coordinate of each point of intersection of y x x 2 6 2 = + - and y x x 3 2 2 = + - . x = .................. and x = .................. [2]

content.tex: Find the x-coordinate of each point of intersection of \(y = 2x^{2} +x-6\) and \(y = 3+2x-x^{2}\) .
